sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the story chapter, see The Labyrinth (story chapter).

The Labyrinth, also known as "Labrys", is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the eleventh map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: This location can only be entered with a Labrys access keycard through transiting from Shoreline. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires the Knossos LLC facility key.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.text: All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance Traders will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process.

sections.heading: Spawn chambers
sections.text: Each of the 5 spawns has its entry to the rest of the location blocked by a hazard/trap, which needs to be resolved to not die.

sections.heading: Chamber 1 - Toxic pool
sections.text:
1. Find Key 01

2. Unlock the door in the left side room

3. Press the button on the wall

sections.heading: Chamber 2 - Steam hazard
sections.text:
1. Find Key 02

2. Unlock the red door

3. Find the Valve handwheel on the 2nd floor

4. Apply the handwheel to the pipe next to the yellow door on the 1st floor

sections.heading: Chamber 3 - Fire hazard
sections.text:
1. Find Key 03

2. Unlock the far door

3. Find the BBQ-S43 gas torch

4. Apply the gas torch to the door at the start

5. Press the button at the electrical cabinet

sections.heading: Chamber 4 - Shotgun trap
sections.text:
1. Find Key 04

2. Unlock the 2nd door

3. Crawl into the connected room

4. Pull the lever to the left of the door

5. Breach the door

sections.heading: Chamber 5 - Toxic puddle
sections.text:
1. Find the BBQ-S43 gas torch

2. Apply the gas torch to the round door in the left side room

3. Pull the lever on the wall

sections.heading: Tripwires
sections.text: The tripwires placed by Shadow of Tagilla on raid start have set locations. They automatically disarm after 20 minutes and don't get set off by Shadow of Tagilla.

sections.heading: Poisoned barbed wire
sections.text: The barbed wire has set locations, but it is random in which it appears every raid. Upon contact, there is a chance to get inflicted with the effect, which deals gradual damage over time (140 HP/minute). It can be treated with an xTG-12 or Perfotoran injector.

sections.heading: Spike pits
sections.text: The pits are always present in set locations, but randomly open or closed every raid.

sections.heading: Alarm
sections.text: Whenever a player goes near the center of the labyrinth, an alarm sounds. It can be deactivated with multiple buttons spread across the location.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- This location was originally only planned to be a temporary addition for the Labyrinth event. After overwhelmingly positive player feedback, the devs decided to permanently keep it in the game.
- Scavs in this location are better equipped than regular ones and sometimes carry xTG-12 injectors.
- Scavs in this location have Greek mythology names such as Μορφέας (Morpheus) and Πύθων (Python). This follows the overall Greek theme of related entities (Knossos, Ariadne) and items (Labrys).
